last_amend_reason: scripts/verify.sh and scripts/check_verify_contracts.py: make verify can finally see the three S8 release blockers it exists to enforce. MEASURED BEFORE, on the pinned tree: pytest --collect-only collected 7,391 tests and ZERO of them were under .swarm-loop, so 0 of 120 frozen acceptance criteria and 0 of 3 S8 release blockers ran inside make verify. The build's headline metric was measured over a file set that excluded the tests deciding whether a release is allowed. The cause was NOT norecursedirs (which does not suppress an explicitly-named path -- measured, 120 tests collect fine with that line untouched) and NOT any pytest exclusion in verify.sh (line 122 is the banned-Redis-reset grep): testpaths simply never listed .swarm-loop and no verify step ever named the acceptance directory. It now runs as its OWN pytest process, because sharing one with apps/packages/services produces 6 phantom failures that vanish in isolation -- measured today. A real run now prints 'ACCEPTANCE: 120/120 frozen criteria passing; S8 release blockers present: S8-1, S8-2, S8-3'. Second half: a Docker-down run used to exit 0 silently having skipped ~15 live Postgres grant tests for C3/S7; it now reports what did not execute instead of looking like a full pass, and with every datastore at a closed port the acceptance step still exits 0, so an offline developer is not blocked -- measured, not asserted. WHAT THIS DOES TO build_succeeds: its command STRING is byte-identical and its VALUE is unmoved (acceptance is 120/120 and 0 skipped with the stack up), but what it MEASURES is deliberately widened, which is the whole point of the change. The widening is monotone-harder: gates were added and none removed, so this metric can go 1->0 but never 0->1, and cannot be gamed upward by it. Every pinned metric command was re-run verbatim afterwards and every one sits exactly at its frozen target: pass-rate 100, total 120, and the nine per-epic counts 8/10/8/21/20/10/26/9/8 all met. MERGE-ORDER CONSTRAINT recorded because it is one-directional: check_verify_contracts.py must never land without verify.sh (new checker + old script is red); the reverse is green. Both landed together in 0dffb80.
